answers.valueEn: Slight hit in the lower bumper chassis on the right side. Oil leak from the timing cover, valve cover, rear crankshaft oil seal, and manifold gasket. Signs of disassembly on the engine oil pan, timing cover, valve cover, and gearbox housing. Simple break in the sun visors. Simple peeling in the front left door upholstery. Hits on the floor. Tear in the front right wheel liner. Break in the engine shield. Tear in the rear left wheel liner. Fading on the gear stick handle. Simple tear in the driver seat upholstery. Break in the trim of the front left door. Scratches on the plastic fender flares (front right/left and rear left). Weak trunk door shocks. Oil leak from the upper turbo hose. Front left fog light not working. Signs of salt deposits on cooling system hoses.
